requirements.requirement: Identify the annual prestigious programming contest in which teams of competitive programmers from universities around the world compete in the final for the prestigious title.
Establish that in a particular year, a team won the championship of that contest, and that this team featured an Australian coder.
Establish that the other two teammates of the Australian coder on that winning team were from the same country.
Identify the Australian coder on that winning team by his competitive programming track record: he secured bronze, silver, gold, and another silver medal in four consecutive IOIs.
Determine the year associated with that championship/title win.
Determine the name of the host university for that year (the year the Australian coder's team won the title).
